Download docker artifacts

Download a Docker image into an OCI image layout directory, &lt;image&gt;-&lt;tag&gt;
under --dir (for example team_app-1.0), without a Docker daemon. The image is
read from the repository: GET /v2/, the token exchange, the manifest, then the
config and every layer. Every blob is checked against the digest of the manifest
before it is stored.

The tag comes from the name (team/app:1.0) or from --version; without either it is
latest. A digest (team/app@sha256:...) pins the manifest. When the tag is a
multi-platform image the platform of this machine is chosen by rp (the registry
does not do it); --platform picks another one, and the layout holds only that
platform. Read the layout with skopeo, crane or 'rp push docker'.

```
rp download docker <image>[:<tag>|@<digest>] [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --dir string        Directory to store the file in (created when missing) (default ".")
      --force             Replace the file when it already exists
      --platform string   Platform to pull from a multi-platform image, os/arch[/variant] (default: the platform of this machine)
      --repo string       Repository to download from (required)
      --version string    Version to download (default: the newest the format knows)
```
